newsitem.title: USA: NY police find canister labeled chemical sarin.
newsitem.headline: NY police find canister labeled chemical sarin.

text.p: Police discovered Wednesday night a canister labeled sarin, a chemical warfare agent used in an attack on the Japanese subway system, a police spokesman said.

While on a credit card fraud investigation in the borough of Queens, police found at least three canisters, one containing compressed air, one containing ether and one labeled sarin, police spokesman Martin Foley said.
"We don't know exactly what's in these tubes," Foley said.
Foley said that police had not determined whether the canister contained sarin and were still questioning a man who insisted it did not, Foley said.
Police cleared the immediate area shortly after their mid-afternoon discovery, he said.
Police did not release an identity or a description of the man, who had not been charged.
